news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.45 (vs ₹4.46 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.45 (down from ₹4.46 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹16.9m (down 43% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹8.68m (down 67% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 52% (down from 91% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was primarily driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 86% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 72% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Eforu Entertainment Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 140.9135 million in funding
news.body: Eforu Entertainment Limited announced a private placement to issue 1,548,500 Equity shares at an issue price of INR 91 for the proceeds of INR 140,913,500 on May 6, 2026. Transaction involves participation of Amit Pankaj Vedawala for 298,900  shares, Global 9 LLC for 1,195,800 shares and Dilip Modi for 53,800 shares as investor. Transaction is approved by board of directors and is still subject to approval of regulatory/ statutory authorities and the shareholders of the Company at the ensuing Extra Ordinary General Meeting.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
